title: FIR Interpolation
text: Perform polyphase FIR interpolation, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Rounding mode} sets Rounding mode; {Coefficient source} sets the fIR filter coefficient source, {FIR filter coefficients}, {Interpolation factor}, {Filter object}, {Input processing} sets the method to process input signals Columns, {Rate options} sets the method by which block interpolates input Enforce single-rate, {Output buffer initial conditions} sets the initial conditions, {View Filter Response}, {Saturate on integer overflow}, {Coefficients Data Type}, {Coefficients Minimum} sets the minimum value of filter coefficients, {Coefficients Maximum} sets the maximum value of filter coefficients, {Product output Data Type}, {Accumulator Data Type}, {Output Data Type}, {Output Minimum} sets the minimum value of block output, {Output Maximum} sets the maximum value of block output and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Coefficient source
params.values: FIR filter coefficient source Auto (default) | Dialog parameters | Input port | Filter object

params.name: FIR filter coefficients
params.values: Lowpass FIR filter coefficients designMultirateFIR(3,1) (default) | vector

params.name: Input processing
params.values: Method to process input signals Columns as channels (frame based) (default) | Elements as channels (sample based)

params.name: Rate options
params.values: Method by which block interpolates input Enforce single-rate processing (default) | Allow multirate processing

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Saturate on integer overflow off (default) | on

params.name: Coefficients Data Type
params.values: Coefficients data type Inherit: Same word length as input (default) | fixdt(1,16) | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Coefficients Minimum
params.values: Minimum value of filter coefficients [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Coefficients Maximum
params.values: Maximum value of filter coefficients [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Product output Data Type
params.values: Product output data type Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Accumulator Data Type
params.values: Accumulator data type Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Output Data Type
params.values: Output data type Inherit: Same as accumulator (default) | Inherit: Same as input | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Output Minimum
params.values: Minimum value of block output [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output Maximum
params.values: Maximum value of block output [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
